title: Calibrate phonon relaxation time parameters to bulk silicon thermal conductivity
action: Calibrate the coefficients for impurity (Rayleigh-like ∝ ω⁴), normal (∝ ω² T³), and umklapp (∝ ω² / sinh(ħω/kbT)) scattering, combined via Matthiessen's rule, so that the BTE solver reproduces known bulk silicon thermal conductivity over the temperature range 50–400 K. Use acoustic phonon dispersion from Pop et al. 2004.

title: Compute steady-state thermal conductance of silicon nanofilms
action: Run the BTE solver in steady state with specular lateral boundaries (film mode) for a range of film thicknesses at 300 K. Compute thermal conductance for each thickness and store results in a CSV file.
description: CSV file with thermal conductance vs film thickness at 300 K. Data should cover ballistic, transition, and diffusive regimes.
output_schema: CSV with columns: thickness_nm (numeric), conductance_W_per_K (numeric). At least 10 data points.

title: Compute steady-state thermal conductivity of silicon nanowires
action: Run the BTE solver in steady state with diffuse lateral boundaries (wire mode) for diameters 37, 56, and 115 nm at temperatures 50, 100, 150, 200, 250, 300, 350, 400 K. Compute thermal conductivity for each condition and store results.
description: CSV file with thermal conductivity vs temperature for the three nanowire diameters. Data should match the expected trends.
output_schema: CSV with columns: diameter_nm (numeric), temperature_K (numeric), thermal_conductivity_W_per_mK (numeric). At least 24 rows (3 diameters × 8 temperatures).

title: Simulate transient temperature evolution in a nanofilm and a nanowire
action: Run the time-dependent BTE solver for a 1 µm thick film (specular boundaries) and a 1 µm long, 37 nm diameter nanowire (diffuse boundaries) with initial temperature around 10 K. Impose a temperature step at one end, and record the temperature at the midpoint at several time instants. Store the time series.
description: CSV file with transient temperature at the midpoint for the film and the nanowire. The film should exhibit ballistic steps, the nanowire a smooth diffusive rise.
output_schema: CSV with columns: system (string: 'film' or 'nanowire'), time_ns (numeric), position (string: 'midpoint'), temperature_K (numeric). Provide data for both systems covering the time range where the transient occurs.
